channel.title: Lifetime Firehorse Store — Sovereign AI Products & Services
channel.description: Sovereign AI products and services for enterprises and SMEs. EU-hosted, CLOUD Act free. Climate compliance, industrial AI, and expert advisory by Lifetime Oy.

item.g:title: Lifetime DWS IQ Platform (Version 6)
item.g:description: Stop risking fines and lost tenders. DWS IQ 6 deploys 18+ Skilled Agents with agentic loops (observe-think-act) to amplify Fit for 55, CSRD, and EPBD compliance across 20 EU industries — cutting 90% of manual compliance hours while producing audit-ready documentation. MCP-native, CLI-accessible, EU-hosted.

item.g:title: Firehorse Amplify
item.g:description: Manual data entry is where compliance fines start. Firehorse Amplify eliminates human error with event-driven workflows for Fit for 55, CSRD, and EPBD 2028 — capturing ESG data directly from your systems with a complete audit trail.

item.g:title: Climate Reporting Starter Bundle
item.g:description: Everything you need to go from zero to compliant. Includes DWS IQ Base Platform, Firehorse Report Module, and a hands-on Kickoff Workshop. Built for companies facing their first CSRD reporting deadline. Operational in 30 days.

item.g:title: Firehorse Omnichannel Next
item.g:description: Launch climate-tech products without greenwashing risk. AI-powered marketing engine that ensures every claim meets EU AI Act and Green Claims Directive requirements. Includes 4-week pilot campaign with measurable results.

item.g:title: DWS IQ Report
item.g:description: Replace 200+ hours of manual report building with one automated template. Fit for 55 compliant dashboards with SAP integration, real-time data feeds, and 4-week validation included. Your compliance team gets their weekends back.

item.g:title: Firehorse Signed Reports
item.g:description: Add legally binding eSignatures to any Firehorse report. Compliance reports, carbon assessments, and investor reports get DocuSign eSignature — court-defensible, audit-ready, with full tracking. Author, reviewer, and auditor sign in sequence. Signed PDFs auto-archived.

item.g:title: Firehorse Content Management
item.g:description: When auditors ask for proof, find it in seconds — not days. Evidence Vault auto-tags compliance documents, alerts before certificates expire, and provides semantic search across all your audit-ready documentation.

item.g:title: Workshop 3 Days - Expert Advisory & Implementation _OLD
item.g:description: Three days that save your team three months. Intensive hands-on workshop covering compliance report design, workflow automation, and strategic roadmap for Fit for 55, CSRD, and EU AI Act. Leave with working implementations, not just slide decks.

item.g:title: Senior Specialist – Hourly Consulting
item.g:description: Expert compliance guidance without a long-term commitment. Book by the hour for Fit for 55, CSRD, EU AI Act, or governance challenges across all 16 regulated EU industries. Most clients start with a 4-hour assessment.

item.g:title: Expert Advisory & Implementation _OLD
item.g:description: Your dedicated compliance strategist. Monthly retainer for ongoing report design, workflow optimization, and board-level advisory on Fit for 55, CSRD, and EU AI Act. Clients typically reduce compliance costs by 40% within the first quarter.

item.g:title: Consulting Fit for 55 Specialist
item.g:description: Direct access to the architect of DWS IQ 6. Monthly co-working with Risto Anton on Fit for 55 compliance, report design, agent coordination, and CxO-level strategy. For organizations that need the person who built the platform, not a junior consultant.

item.g:title: AI Engineering & Cloud Solutions Consultancy
item.g:description: 25 hours of senior cloud architect time to assess, plan, and implement your AI and cloud infrastructure. Multi-cloud expertise across AWS, Azure, GCP. Includes a complimentary 4-hour strategy workshop to identify quick wins and avoid costly mistakes.

item.g:title: Conversational Agent Solution
item.g:description: Deploy AI agents where your team already works — WhatsApp, Teams, Zoom, or a secure webhook. Custom conversational agents for enterprise workflows with your choice of LLM (Claude, GPT, Groq, or self-hosted for data sovereignty). Live in 25 hours.

item.g:title: Microsoft 365 Agent Consultancy
item.g:description: Build Declarative Agents and Custom Engine Agents for Microsoft 365 Copilot, Teams, and Office using the Microsoft 365 Agents Toolkit (ATK) — the evolution of Teams Toolkit. Zero-configuration approach with built-in M365 identity, Microsoft Graph, and Azure integration. 8 hours of expert engagement.

item.g:title: AI & Agent Engineering
item.g:description: Hire a senior AI engineer by the hour — no recruitment overhead. Available as AI Product Manager, Solutions Architect, or ML Engineer for Azure AI Foundry, Google AI Studio, or custom agentic AI projects. Skip the 3-month hiring cycle.

item.g:title: AI Project Accelerator
item.g:description: Ship your next project in half the time. Lean methodology powered by AI tools — includes planning workshop, backlog setup, Kanban workflows, and roadmap. Teams using this approach see 2x delivery speed within the first sprint.

item.g:title: AI Consultant Day
item.g:description: One day to unblock your AI strategy. Senior consultant on-site or remote for strategy, prototyping, and hands-on implementation. Covers Claude, GPT, Gemini Pro, Copilot, and Azure AI Studio. Most clients book 2–3 days for a full sprint.

item.g:title: Business Mentor - AI Strategy 30 Hours
item.g:description: 30 hours of strategic AI mentoring, scheduled on your terms. Cover AI strategy, business process redesign with agents, and Copilot adoption in flexible 4–8 hour sessions over 12 months. Ideal for leadership teams navigating AI transformation.

item.g:title: EU AI Act Literacy Training
item.g:description: Your leadership team needs AI fluency — not just your engineers. EU AI Act Article 4 now requires AI literacy across your organization. In-house coaching with a free 3-hour workshop to assess readiness. Personal, team, or remote.

item.g:title: AI Customer Agent
item.g:description: Turn every customer interaction into a conversion opportunity. AI-powered prompt flow agent that continuously optimizes your service experience and drives measurable sales growth. Setup and first results in under 2 weeks.

item.g:title: Firehorse Omnichannel & Multimodal AI Assistant
item.g:description: Stop guessing which channels convert. AI-optimized campaign management across all your marketing channels with daily performance measurement and automated optimization. Know exactly where your next customer is coming from.

item.g:description: GDPR-compliant email in one business day. Full Proton Business Suite — encrypted email, cloud storage, password manager, and VPN. Meets GDPR, NIS2, and EU AI Act requirements. 8-hour implementation, fully operational by end of day.

item.g:title: Firehorse Data Services
item.g:description: Your data is worth more than you think. API-driven data products, brokerage strategy, and enrichment services that turn raw operational data into revenue and compliance insights. Remote and on-site consulting available.

item.g:title: Agentti Sanasto Englanti-Suomi
item.g:description: Master AI agent terminology in Finnish. Comprehensive English-to-Finnish glossary covering all key agentic AI concepts with detailed explanations. Essential reference for Finnish tech teams working with international AI tools.

item.g:description: Find out if your factory floor is AI-ready in 2 weeks. Complete manufacturing intelligence assessment with workflow scoring, ROI projection, automated deployment, performance dashboard, and 30-day monitoring. Clear go/no-go for your next investment.

item.g:title: Digital Design Gold

From identity system to live campaign intelligence in one engagement.

item.g:title: On-Demand AI & Cloud Engineers
item.g:description: Need expert developers this week, not next quarter? Pre-vetted cloud and AI professionals ready for immediate deployment. Skip the 3-month recruitment cycle and start building today.

item.g:description: Transform your team from AI-curious to AI-productive in 3 days. In-house training covering strategy, hands-on implementation, and tool adoption. EU AI Act Article 4 requires AI literacy — this programme gets you compliant and productive.

item.g:title: AI Consulting – Agentic Software Development
item.g:description: Your competitors are shipping 10x faster with AI agents. We assess your codebase, run AGENTS.md workshops, restructure for agentic development, and set up quality governance — from practitioners building with Claude Code and Codex daily. 88% of enterprises are increasing agentic AI budgets in 2026.

item.g:title: Control Room — Acer Veriton GN100 + NVIDIA Model Install
item.g:description: When your team needs a sovereign AI brain that lives in your own building. One Acer Veriton GN100 (20 cores, 120 GiB RAM) + on-site NVIDIA model installation, configured for your operations. Used by Lifetime as the command brain — and built for places like VPK (vapaapalokunta) where decisions can't wait for a cloud round-trip. Pick the model bundle that fits how you work.

item.g:title: Situation Room — 2× Acer Veriton GN100 Bridged + NVIDIA Model Bundle
item.g:description: When one node isn't enough — and the situation is bigger than a single screen. Two Acer Veriton GN100 nodes bridged for parallel inference, plus a wider NVIDIA model bundle covering vision, acoustic, language and reasoning. Built for dual-use scenarios like VPK drone defense: detect the threat with vision + acoustic models, coordinate the response with reasoning + voice models, log everything for the audit. Pick your bundle. Sovereign by default.

item.g:title: NVIDIA Model Installation — Per Edge Device
item.g:description: Add-on service: install and tune the NVIDIA model stack on one edge device. Includes CUDA drivers, model bundle of your choice (Qwen, Llama, Whisper, vision/acoustic models), OpenSandbox isolation, MCP endpoint, and a sanity-tested first run. Bundled into Control Room and Situation Room products — buy this separately when adding nodes to an existing fleet.

item.g:title: Sovereign Database — EU Data Sovereignty for PostgreSQL

Zero CLOUD Act exposure. Available August 2026.
